name: fraud-detector
intended_use: The model is a fraud transactions detection model (based amount threshold,like amount threshold classifier). The intented users are the banking and online payments systems.
training_data: The model is trained on card_id and max_amount from [card_id,transaction count,avg_amount,max_amount,% card present and event time]. It only covers the max amount from a transactions under a card, it doesn;t considers the distribution of the transcations made by the card.
limitations: It doesn't consider the cumulative transactions to be fraudulent. A card could have multiple small transaction less than threshold, in a short duration of time to by pass the amount-threshold classifier. Hence the model cannot be trusted.
ethical_considerations: the cost of a false positive here (a legitimate transaction blocked) leads to customers loosing confidence with the banking system, they might what to move to new vendor. And in false negetive case, where a fraudulent transactions takes place the customers looses there money. The banks needs to held accountable on how the classify and handle these cases.
